blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo Lacson said he is praying and hoping that Sen. Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa’s arrest will be carried out “peacefully, without violence or tragedy,” stressing that he is still entitled to due process despite his faults. Aside from being a colleague in the Senate, Lacson noted that Dela Rosa was his former subordinate in the Philippine National Police (PNP) and a fellow Philippine Military Academy (PMA) Cavalier. “I sincerely hope and pray that should his arrest take place sooner or later, it will be carried out peacefully, without violence or tragedy,” Lacson said in a post on […]...
